name: Example Corp
conventions: Container images are built by GitHub Actions, pushed to JFrog Artifactory first and then to Artifact Registry.
Use workload_identity for keyless GitHub -> Google Cloud deployments and iam for runtime service accounts.
Every LLM call goes through the internal gateway "Brain" (kind llm_gateway).
defaults: When unspecified: Google Cloud in europe-west3, JFrog -> Artifact Registry, Workload Identity Federation, Secret Manager, Cloud Logging, the Brain gateway for LLMs.
